purpose: Stored native results for the Codex helper route (main session to named helper). Native rows are real launches on the owner's computer; hook rows run the installed hook process with crafted events. Nothing reads this file yet; the install check reads only the Claude Code file.

native_cases.observed: served gpt-6-luna at max effort in the child session log, matching the rendered helper file

native_cases.observed: refused: only toolkit-g0-helper and toolkit-g1-helper are allowed

native_cases.observed: refused: helper launches cannot override the model

runs.hook_not_passed_reason: Stale runner case: it expected an unbound named-helper launch to be refused, but the main session may launch a Toolkit helper on its installed route, so admission is correct. The case is corrected in the runner; the corrected runner passes 27 of 27 on Linux.

known_limits.summary: Codex does not block when a hook cannot start, crashes, times out, or is missing, disabled or untrusted, so the helper guard fails open in those cases. On Windows the PowerShell launcher denies a helper launch when it cannot start Node.
Codex sends hooks no caller-agent identity, so a helper that launches another helper cannot be refused; leaf depth stays an instruction.
